config_intent: first diagnostic proposal-generation configuration only; not an experiment result and not tuned from evaluation metrics

global_generation_limits.max_total_proposals_per_target_rationale: 27 shell-grid proposals plus 5 energy/contrast and 5 connected-component hypotheses keeps the first diagnostic bounded while allowing shell and SAR-evidence routes to coexist.
global_generation_limits.deduplicate_across_routes_policy: merge exact same route_config_id target_identity cx cy w h theta after full-image coordinate conversion; preserve all contributing route names in provenance
global_generation_limits.deduplicate_across_routes_rationale: prevents accidental duplicate inflation without using GT or Phase5C metrics.

crop_policy.rationale: 512 px gives SAR evidence room around the A005 proxy without turning the diagnostic into unconstrained full-image search; the value is fixed before any GT/oracle review.

coordinate_policy.rationale: Phase5C evaluation and A005 proxy fields use full-image pixel coordinates, so crop-local evidence must be mapped back before output.

valid_support_policy.rationale: no frozen fan-valid mask exists, so first-run A/B/C use image bounds only and avoid Route D fan/range claims.

theta_policy.rationale: first-round routes diagnose center/extent hypotheses; theta is carried only to satisfy schema and must not be interpreted as SAR long-axis evidence.

shell_grid.max_proposals_per_target_rationale: 3 scales times a 3x3 symmetric offset grid gives a bounded coverage baseline without dense brute-force search.

shell_margin_policy.rationale: shell bounds are not precomputed; the A005-centered crop defines the local diagnostic search region.

shell_grid.scale_set_rationale: three symmetric extent hypotheses test smaller, prior-sized, and larger support without tuning to target outcomes.
shell_grid.offset_grid_rationale: offsets are relative to A005 prior size, symmetric around the proxy center, and fixed before any evaluation.
shell_grid.theta_modes_rationale: no rotated or SAR-derived orientation claim is made in the first diagnostic round.

energy_contrast_peak.max_proposals_per_target_rationale: five peaks are enough to expose multiple SAR-supported center hypotheses while preventing the route from becoming dense search.
energy_contrast_peak.energy_peak_count_rationale: fixed top-k count avoids threshold tuning from Phase5C metrics.

local_background_policy.rationale: robust crop-local contrast is simple, reproducible, and does not require GT labels; border exclusion reduces crop-edge artifacts without tuning to outcomes.

peak_suppression_policy.radius_rationale: 32 px is smaller than the A005 vehicle-width prior scale but large enough to avoid repeated samples on one bright blob.

window_extent_policy.rationale: energy peaks define centers only; using the A005 prior extent prevents this route from silently tuning box size.

connected_component.max_proposals_per_target_rationale: five components cap clutter-driven output while leaving room for fragmented visible SAR support.

component_threshold_family.rationale: Otsu and a fixed high-percentile threshold are simple, label-free threshold families; no Phase5C metric selects between them.

component_size_filter.rationale: relative area limits avoid tiny speckle and full-crop clutter while staying tied to prior/crop scale rather than GT boxes.

component_selection_policy.rationale: selection is deterministic and inference-side; it does not use IoU, center error, or condition labels.

component_merge_policy.rationale: first run records fragmentation instead of tuning merge rules from post-hoc quality metrics.

boundary_touching_policy.rationale: fan-edge and partial support may touch boundaries, so first run should flag rather than discard these cases.

radial_range_profile.reason: fan/range convention and valid support mapping not frozen

ridge_long_axis.reason: orientation/long-axis convention not ready for first center_extent diagnostic

factor_graph_over_generated_proposals.reason: Phase5D only after proposal ceiling audit

active_c3_c4_integration.reason: Phase5B diagnostic outputs must remain separate from C3/C4

hybrid_shell_sar_ranker.reason: hybrid scoring can become hidden ranker tuning before proposal ceiling audit

output_schema.proposal_id_policy: new Phase5B proposal ids only; do not reuse A001 candidate_id

forbidden_feedback: changing v0 thresholds after seeing Phase5C metrics
using condition labels to select route parameters
